messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick preflight — planning to push model-serving v2.2 to canary at 14:00 PST today. Posting the undo matrix + who needs to ack. Please reply with your role (monitor/rollback/hold)

Kevin Li: I'll own smoke checks + metrics dashboards. Will run perf smoke and run latency/throughput script.

Sophie Tran: I can be on rollback if we need to revert feature flags or scale down the new pool.

Ash Patel: I'll be on-call for infra rollback (k8s/infra toggles). Not planning DB changes but will watch replica counts.

Maria Gomez: TL;DR rollback criteria I'm using (if any hit -> start rollback):
- >3% error rate (5xx) sustained for 5m on canary
- p50 latency regression > 30% vs baseline for 10m
- failed inference correctness on golden prompt set (more than 4/10 failures)

Maria Gomez: Undo matrix (commands and feature flags) — copy/paste if you need to run revert quickly:
```bash
# rollback deployment to previous stable revision
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment model-server --to-revision=217

# scale canary down and route traffic back to stable
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-server-canary --replicas=0
# flip routing flag in gateway service
redwood-cli gateway toggle --route model-serving:stable
```

Maria Gomez: Feature flags / toggles: `ff:model_v2_canary` controlled in LaunchDarkly. Also `routing:prefer-stable` for immediate failback.

DeployBot: Scheduled deployment queued by @maria for 2025-08-01T14:00:00-08:00. Canary window: 20m. Notifications will post to #eng-releases.

Kevin Li: Smoke script I'm running (paste):
```python
# quick synthetic smoke: 50 requests, check latency & success
for i in range(50):
  resp = client.generate(prompt=golden_prompts[i % len(golden_prompts)])
  assert resp.status == 200
  # record latencies
```

Sophie Tran: If we need immediate rollback, my steps are: 1) trigger k8s undo (Ash helps), 2) flip LaunchDarkly flag to false, 3) verify golden set locally, 4) announce rollback complete in thread.

Jordan: Can someone confirm who is running post-deploy synthetic at +5m and +15m?

Kevin Li: I'll do +5m and +15m checks. Sophie can do +10m verification on correctness. Ash will watch infra/slo console continuously.

Maria Gomez: Owners ack please (reply with just GO/HOLD):
- Maria (release lead)
- Kevin (smoke)
- Sophie (correctness)
- Ash (infra)

Kevin Li: GO :thumbsup:

Sophie Tran: GO

Ash Patel: GO, standing by

Maria Gomez: GO — proceeding with canary at 14:00. If anything anomalous, call rollback and tag the thread. Keep messages short in the window.

Jordan: Noted, will monitor logs and trace errors.

DeployBot: Deploy started: model-serving v2.2 canary. Canary pod ids: model-server-canary-7f9bcd

Kevin Li: +5m smoke: p50 latency +12% (within threshold), error rate 0.4% — continuing.

Sophie Tran: +10m correctness: golden set 9/10 pass, one mismatch due to tokenization edge — filing small ticket, not blocking.

Ash Patel: infra metrics stable, no OOMs, replica count healthy.

Maria Gomez: Canary window complete, metrics look OK. Rolling forward to 30% traffic per rollout plan. Thanks everyone.

Kevin Li: Will post final summary in #eng-releases after full rollout.
